title: SbomIndexContribution
description: Sealed, byte-stable handle + manifest for a raw SBOM document produced by an SBOM-generating tool (`syft` in v1; future `cyclonedx` / `spdx` / `trivy` populate the same envelope). The SBOM document itself lives in the BundleStore and is referenced by `nativeAttributes.blobHandle`. Pattern-C universal envelope (SKILL §8bis Rule 2). PRODUCER RULE: this slot has exactly ONE producer per SBOM tool (`SbomKS` in v1). The semantic projection lives in `Repository.SbomComponent`; consumers needing fields beyond the projection (file evidence locations, layer metadata, full purl chains, SPDX relationships) read this slot directly.

id.description: Stable client-defined identity within (panel, slot). Suggested form: '<toolName>|<toolVersion>|<format>|<indexedRevision>'.

tool.description: Pattern-C discriminator (§8bis Rule 2). Identifies the SBOM-producing tool.

format.description: Wire format of the SBOM document.

projectRoot.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the project root the tool was invoked on.

indexedRevision.description: Git revision of the working tree the tool ran on. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Carries the content-addressable handle to the raw SBOM document and its manifest.

blobHandle.description: Content-addressable URI of the raw SBOM document in the BundleStore (e.g. 'bb://blackboard/runs/{bbId}/bundles/sbom/<sha256>.syft.json').

partial.description: True when the SBOM tool reported degraded coverage.
